text:
Sarah: kicking off online migration: add column last_active_at TIMESTAMP + TTL index on last_active_at. Quiet window 25m. starting @deploybot now, pls ack and watch for holdpoints.

deploybot: job started: mig-3265432101 on pg-cluster-6. running chunked backfill (chunk_size=3k). auto-pause if lock_wait > 9s OR replica_lag > 50s for >60s. logs -> https://deploy/logs/mig-3265432101 :robot_face:

Mike: moved the daily cohort export outside window. i'll throttle report-worker to 0.2 qps for the table.

Ivy: adding to release notes: "Add last_active_at + TTL index. Migration performed in quiet window; read-compatible." pinning to v2.2.1-rc1.

SRE-Oncall: define soft pause vs rollback and an escape hatch. Please add temporary alerts for p95 write latency and replica lag.

Sarah: Pause (soft) triggers: single lock_wait >9s OR replica_lag >50s sustained >60s OR p95 write latency >320ms for 2m -> deploybot pauses and posts holdpin. Full rollback triggers: job fails twice OR sustained write errors >30% for 5m OR customer error rate >2% above baseline for 3m. Escape hatch: `release:abort-mig-3265432101` to pin and stop. Quick rollback snippet:
```
# stop migrator
systemctl stop migrator || true
# kill active DDLs
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ~ 'ALTER TABLE customer_profiles' AND state <> 'active';
# revert schema
ALTER TABLE customer_profiles DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS last_active_at;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_customer_profiles_last_active_ttl;
```
Full runbook: /runbooks/migrations/customer_profiles.md.

deploybot: acknowledged. progress: processed_rows=9,800; throughput ~130 rows/s; no pause conditions yet. Posting perf snapshot to metrics.

Mike: replica drain done, lag ~6-8s. Monitoring tail.

Ivy: noted, will include gating: TTL enforcement enabled after 10 days validation.

SRE-Oncall: temporary alerts set (write_p95>350ms, replica_lag>60s). muting noisy alerts for window.

Sarah: thanks — next checkpoint at 30k rows or on any holdpin/abort.
